debrief db-021
1) the actor r-e-p-o-r-t-e-d the incident log to the security team and left a r-e-p-o-r-t-f-i-l-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n check
2) the a-c-t-o-r c-a-u-g-h-t the breach attempt with a s-t-a-n-d-a-r-d t-o-o-l and left a l-o-g-e-n-t-r-y while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-u-d-i-t-t-r-a-i-l check
3) the a-c-t-o-r r-e-m-o-v-e-d the compromised device from the network and left a d-e-v-i-c-e-t-a-g while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the f-o-r-e-n-s-i-c-s c-h-e-c-k
4) the a-c-t-o-r r-e-s-t-o-r-e-d the access permissions to normal and left a p-e-r-m-i-s-s-i-o-n-s file while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the r-e-v-i-e-w-a-l check
5) the a-c-t-o-r c-o-m-m-u-n-i-c-a-t-e-d the fix to the client and left a c-l-i-e-n-t-n-o-t-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-l-o-s-u-r-e c-h-e-c-k
